title: The unprinted year, iv · the line comes back
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Six months in. The line tightens again — cross-hatch back, spotting back, balloons lettered — for nobody. Box 5 is nearly full. He letters the lid a week early. In the corner: a scanner, still boxed.

panels.composition: The bedroom. WOOD at the desk. The line is tight again — tighter than 2002, the spotting exact. BARNABY watching. A cardboard box on the floor, full of strips, the flaps open.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, tight precise line with heavy spotting, a young man drawing at a desk with a dog watching and a cardboard box on the floor overflowing with comic strips

panels.composition: The pad. The strip he's drawing: the dog under the table, redrawn, better than 1999 — exact. A lettered balloon: 'Still here.'
props: pad: the dog under a table, lettered

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, close-up of a drawing pad showing a small dog under a table drawn with precise confident lines and one lettered speech balloon

panels.composition: Wood setting the strip on top of the box. Not folding the flaps — one week left. Writing on the lid anyway, with a marker.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, a young man writing on the open lid flap of a nearly full cardboard box with a marker

panels.composition: The box, open, on the floor. On the flap: BOX 5 · JUN 03–DEC 03 · NONE OF IT RAN. The dog's chin on the edge. Under the desk, in the corner of the panel: a flat gray rectangle in a shipping box. A scanner.
props: a scanner in a shipping box
panels.caption: Box 5.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, tight line, an open nearly full cardboard box on a bedroom floor with writing on its flap and a dog resting its chin on the edge, and in the corner a flat scanner still in its shipping box
image.notes: Flap: BOX 5 · JUN 03–DEC 03 · NONE OF IT RAN. Letter after. The box closes in the book at dw_2003-12-19; the scanner is January (dw_2004-01-05).

art.line: brush-pen, tight again; spotting and hatch back; lettered; still no reader

notes: The line comes back for nobody. The lid lettered early. The scanner in the corner. The December strip closes the box a week later.
